messages:
zara: kicking off small canary for v6-int4 at 5% traffic for 2h. main ask: tighten automatic rollback logic without making it too twitchy.
nate: perf looks great (tokens/$ -30%, p95 -22%). but some long-doc coherence drop ~0.9% on a couple slices.
hema: infra: cold KV misses up for ~30-40m depending on shard. recommend warmup_mins=40 to avoid false alarms.
oliver: ops: prefer 3x5m hysteresis windows before auto rollback. immediate manual rollback still allowed.
zara: propose quorum gating: require runtime telemetry + eval harness agree OR eval harness A+B agree. basically 2-of-3 by default.
hema: add bootstrap CI check: require 90% CI lower bound to exceed threshold to count as a vote. also sample_floor=120.
nate: thresholds: critical slices rel-MRR 0.5%, default 1.0%, global hallucination abs 0.7%. after 75m tighten thresholds by 15%.
oliver: rollback plan: stepdown 50%->20%->0 over 3 minutes, backfill to pinned fp32. emit alert to #canary-ops pre-rollback for 10m to allow human abort.
canary-bot: canary started at 5102468013 -> 5% traffic. dashboard: https://console/redwood/canary/5102468013
zara: action items: Hema add warmup+CI gating, Nate finalize slice thresholds, Oliver configure alert window. reconvene after 2h smoke. :rocket:
